nodes.label: @aponiajs/common Agent Guide
nodes.rationale: Defines @aponiajs/common as the platform-neutral contract layer with reflect-metadata as its sole runtime dependency and zero Elysia, HTTP, or Bun runtime APIs.

nodes.label: Metadata-Only Decorator Surface
nodes.rationale: Decorators only record reflect-metadata entries under Symbol.for('aponia.*.metadata') keys and never construct graphs, routes, or containers; @Injectable() stays a no-op solely for emitDecoratorMetadata.

nodes.label: Own-Only Metadata vs Inherited Constructor Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Module, controller, enhancer, and validation metadata use Reflect.getOwnMetadata so subclasses do not inherit parent metadata, whereas design:paramtypes and @Inject() use Reflect.getMetadata so subclasses without a constructor resolve parent constructor tokens.

nodes.label: ValidatorSchema Structural Contract
nodes.rationale: Matches TypeBox 1 builders structurally (~kind, ~refine, ~codec, ~unsafe) with typebox StaticDecode imported type-only so Elysia t schemas arrive without adding a runtime dependency.

nodes.label: Registered Async-Context Exit Boundary
nodes.rationale: Runtimes owning an AsyncLocalStorage register their exit callback via registerAsyncContextExit so background work can call runOutsideAsyncContexts without common importing runtime async-context APIs.

nodes.label: Provider Scope and Durability Model
nodes.rationale: Uses Nest numeric Scope values (DEFAULT=0, TRANSIENT=1, REQUEST=2) while normalizing legacy string scopes once, groups durable REQUEST providers by ContextIdStrategy parent id, and rejects unknown scopes with UNSUPPORTED_PROVIDER_SCOPE.

nodes.label: HttpStatus Dual Namespace Deviation
nodes.rationale: HttpStatus serves as both Nest's numeric status map and the @HttpStatus() response-status parameter decorator, documented in docs/build/migrating-from-nest.md as the one namespace deviation.

nodes.label: Single-Transport ExecutionContext
nodes.rationale: Carries route class, handler, and mounted { method, path } on ArgumentsHost; omits getType() and Nest per-transport dispatch because only one HTTP transport exists.

nodes.label: Closed AponiaError Code Union
nodes.rationale: Framework failures must throw AponiaError with a code from the closed union rather than bare Error instances.
